task_name: Client Auth UI — OAuth Buttons, PickUsername & EmailGate Screens

concerns_addressed: First-pass review of the original done_sha (81d82fc0) flagged DELIVERABLE scenario 7: oauth_error=cancelled message not rendering because setOauthError ran only in the api.me() success branch while a cancelled OAuth makes api.me() reject with 401. Correction commit d78c1b0 ('fix: set oauthError before api.me() so cancelled prop reaches AuthPage on 401') resolves exactly this — setOauthError now runs before/independently of the api.me() chain, so AuthPage receives oauthError='cancelled' on the user=null path. App.test.tsx now covers both the cancelled and no-error paths. Verdict re-evaluated against the union of original range + correction d78c1b0.

strengths: All must-haves verified: OAuth buttons use api.startOAuth which sets window.location.href (api.ts:177-181, not fetch); User type extended with username:string|null, emailVerified:boolean, needsUsername:boolean (types.ts:24-31); App.tsx state machine checks BOTH needsUsername then emailVerified in correct order (App.tsx:107-110)
Single api.me() effect confirmed — the new session-check useEffect (App.tsx:92-104) replaces the old one; me() does not fire twice

AuthPage renders 'Login cancelled — try again' on oauthError (AuthPage.tsx:163-167); PickUsernamePage calls api.setUsername then api.me then onComplete (PickUsernamePage.tsx:24-26); EmailGatePage has Link Google + Link GitHub calling api.startOAuth (EmailGatePage.tsx)
SettingsPage set-password section gated on user.emailVerified with >=8 char validation and ApiError handling (SettingsPage.tsx:277-296, 479-521)
Correction d78c1b0 correctly moves setOauthError before api.me() so the cancelled prop reaches AuthPage even when me() rejects with 401; App.test.tsx covers both paths
make typecheck passes (noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters clean); all client tests pass via npm run test --workspace=client
No must-not violations: no manual email entry form, no unlink button, no client-side token storage; email gate is server-authoritative
Design-system adherence: components use brand Tailwind tokens (primary-600/700, neutral-300, rounded-md, focus-visible outline), Work Sans inherited globally

issues.description: Dead mock: vi.mock("../api") resolves to client/api (nonexistent) but App.tsx imports "./api" (client/src/api). The mock never intercepts App's import. Test passes only because the real api.me() rejects in jsdom, coincidentally driving the same catch→AuthPage path. Mock should target the resolved module or be removed.

'Login cancelled' renders on any truthy oauthError ({oauthError && ...}) rather than strictly oauthError === 'cancelled' as stated in the plan. Behavior equivalent since the server only emits oauth_error=cancelled, but the guard is looser than specified.

Inconsistent error-text color: AuthPage and PickUsernamePage use text-error-900 for inline error text, while SettingsPage uses text-error-600 and the creative-brief specifies error-600. Cosmetic inconsistency.
EmailGatePage Props declares onComplete but it is never used (component relies on full OAuth redirect to drive state). Intentional API symmetry with PickUsernamePage; harmless.
